results: In total, 13 studies were included (191,064 participants in BCG vaccine, 166,283 in Control). With all studies, the pooled risk ratio was 0.49 (95% CI 0.34 to 0.70; I² = 92.1%). Across all 13 omission fits, pooled estimates ranged from 0.45 (omitting TB Prevention Trial, 1980) to 0.54 (omitting Hart & Sutherland, 1977). I² after omission ranged from 83.8% (omitting TB Prevention Trial, 1980) to 92.8% (omitting Coetzee & Berjak, 1968). Table 1 gives every omission fit.

Methods
Statistical analyses were performed using RC MetaStudio (version 0.6.0; Research Consultancy) [1] with the R package metafor (version 5.2.1) [2]. Odds ratios were pooled using a random-effects model with the restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimator of between-study variance [3]. Confidence intervals (95%) used the normal approximation. The meta-regression model included . Regression coefficients and their confidence intervals are on the log scale. Heterogeneity was assessed with Cochran’s Q and I².
Results
In total, 6 studies were included (5,599 participants in , 5,217 in Control); 1 study was excluded. For : Later trials vs Earlier trials (reference), the coefficient was 0.28 (95% CI −0.03 to 0.58; z = 1.79; P = 0.074). Residual heterogeneity: Q = 4.25 (df = 4; P = 0.373); I² = 22.2%; τ² = 0.01. In Earlier trials (reference), the pooled odds ratio was 0.75 (95% CI 0.59 to 0.93). In Later trials, the pooled odds ratio was 0.98 (95% CI 0.80 to 1.21).

Methods
Statistical analyses were performed using RC MetaStudio (version 0.6.0; Research Consultancy) [1] with the R package metafor (version 5.2.1) [2]. Odds ratios were pooled using a random-effects model with the restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimator of between-study variance [3]. Confidence intervals (95%) used the normal approximation. The meta-regression model included . Regression coefficients and their confidence intervals are on the log scale. Heterogeneity was assessed with Cochran’s Q and I².
Results
In total, 6 studies were included (5,599 participants in , 5,217 in Control); 1 study was excluded. For : Later trials vs Earlier trials (reference), the coefficient was 0.2789 (95% CI −0.0268 to 0.5846; z = 1.7879; P = 0.0738). Residual heterogeneity: Q = 4.2540 (df = 4; P = 0.3727); I² = 22.2%; τ² = 0.0088. In Earlier trials (reference), the pooled odds ratio was 0.7453 (95% CI 0.5945 to 0.9343). In Later trials, the pooled odds ratio was 0.9850 (95% CI 0.8018 to 1.2101).
